long_biography.plain_text:
Patseas S.A. grew from an early-1980s shop in Chalandri into an Athenian house for fine watches and jewellery. Nikolaos Fotios Patseas has owned the company since 1984 and serves as its chairman and chief executive. The business now operates in Psychiko and Vouliagmeni, including a dedicated Rolex boutique at Astir Marina.

Alongside retailing international watch and jewellery houses, Patseas maintains an Athens workshop where jewellers draw, set and finish bespoke pieces and watchmakers service timepieces in-house. It is an authorised retailer and service point for Rolex and Tudor. Patseas also expanded into Swiss watch ownership through Montres Venus in Geneva, a revived brand whose current company dates from 2011.
